description: Stokesbary showed continued support and dedication through the high-stakes discussions of the consumer data privacy legislation. He played an important role as the ranking minority member on the House Appropriations Committee and is always working hard to stop new taxes from impacting the business community.

title: Washington Hospitality Association names Stokesbary "2020 Legislative Hero" - Re-Elect Drew Stokesbary
